system.description: Petitions the dying stars for an answer to one question about past events or present locations. Questions about other realms suffer -5 external penalty. Successes: 1+ vague, 4+ incomplete but enlightening, 7+ somewhat accurate, 10+ accurate with details. Botch gives incorrect answer. Yozis/Primordials/Neverborn botch automatically. Malfean Astrology; only works in Malfeas.
